items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you recorded with McCoy Tyner... paired up McCoy with Alphonse Mouzon... Afro-Blue, I remember that specifically, because that’s the opening cut, and it’s you.

ctx.x: One of the signature tunes. In April – April 6th, 1973, you recorded with McCoy Tyner, Song of the New World, his big-band arrangements, his arrangements. For me, another one of those benchmark recordings, because it paired up McCoy with Alphonse Mouzon. That was – Alphonse, coming out of Weather Report, we’re all trying – all of the drummers trying to figure, okay, where’s Alphonse going after this? He goes to McCoy. Song of the New World. Afro-Blue, I remember that specifically, because that’s the opening cut,…
